summary.headline: Wisconsin gas averages $3.73/gal
summary.blurb: Regular gas is averaging $3.73 a gallon across Wisconsin as of July 18, 2026, according to GasBuddy. AAA figures put the statewide average 9¢ higher than a week ago, 2¢ lower than a month ago, and 83¢ higher than a year ago. Drivers are finding the lowest metro average in Milwaukee ($3.46) and the highest in Superior ($3.98).
